hideDuplicateMode.name: hideDuplicateMode
hideDuplicateMode.description: Hide duplicate mode when switching display modes
hideDuplicateMode.description[zh_CN]: 配置为 true 时，切换显示模式时不显示复制模式

hideExtendMode.name: hideExtendMode
hideExtendMode.description: Hide extend mode when switching display modes
hideExtendMode.description[zh_CN]: 配置为 true 时，切换显示模式时不显示扩展模式

hideSingleMode.name: hideSingleMode
hideSingleMode.description: Hide all single-output modes when switching display modes
hideSingleMode.description[zh_CN]: 配置为 true 时，切换显示模式时不显示所有仅单屏模式
